highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison tools and corrects runtime-effect uniforms and texture-edge sampling.
highlights_body: The unreleased line introduces a separate SkiaSharp.Testing package for visual assertions and difference diagnostics. It also changes Tizen's CPU blur selection and drops Linux x86 native assets.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications targeting 32-bit Linux must move to a supported Linux architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package adds SKImageComparison for images, bitmaps and pixmaps, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and five difference-image styles. Opt in to the experimental API by suppressing SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Results retain no native handles; dispose returned difference images yourself.

New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers now contain zeros rather than uninitialized memory. Reset clears the existing buffer in place, restoring the documented zero state without allocating a replacement native buffer or wrapper. Tests cover both runtime effects and meshes.

bullets.lead: Filtered texture samples stay inside subsets
bullets.detail: Ganesh uses inward texture-subset clamping to avoid sampling undefined exterior texels at filtered edges, and avoids direct linear copies at affected logical texture edges. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected.

bullets.lead: Tizen CPU blur selection takes effect
bullets.detail: Tizen now applies its blur-path setting when compiling Skia, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the supporting change.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Corrected uniform-buffer initialization and reset behavior, and disposed ToData snapshots in tests.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and Uno views projects to the Windows samples solution.
